console_archive.contents: exactly the 12 raw console logs from the raw evidence directory
console_archive.deterministic_mtime_note: tar was built with a fixed deterministic mtime (2026-09-07 00:00:00 UTC). Because that fixed mtime was slightly later than the verifier's wall-clock time at the moment of an immediate post-creation extraction check, tar printed a 'timestamp ... is N s in the future' warning for each extracted file. This is NOT an integrity failure: extraction return code was 0 and every extracted file's SHA256 matched E7_V1_1_CONSOLE_LOGS_RAW.sha256 (12/12 OK). Recorded here so the warning is never later misclassified as corruption.
